svg.title: Graph diffusion: one explicit Euler step
svg.desc: A four-node ring whose nodes carry values u. Every edge carries conductivity times the difference between the source and destination values toward its destination; each node then advances by a small time step times its net inflow.
svg.text: Graph diffusion: one explicit Euler step
every edge carries conductivity times the value difference toward its destination; each node then steps by dt times its net inflow
